newsitem.title: IRAQ: Iraq cuts electricity fees - newspapers.
newsitem.headline: Iraq cuts electricity fees - newspapers.

text.p: Iraq's President Saddam Hussein has ordered a reduction of up to 71 per cent in power fees in the country, government newspapers reported on Sunday.
"President leader Saddam Hussein ordered that power fees for household consumption be lowered by 20 to 71 per cent," the papers said.
The order came a day after Babel, the newspaper of Saddam's eldest son Uday, complained about the soaring power, telephone and drinking water bills in Iraq.
"Salaries of civil servants...are not enough even to pay for the exaggerated bills of electricity and telephones," Babel said in a front-page editorial on Saturday.
The government early this year demanded an economic price for utilities as part of a package of measures to reform the economy. It raised power, telephone and water rates nearly five fold.
